AcidicConcoctionPlayer.description: Consume charges from your Mana Flask to throw a flask that explodes, dealing Physical Attack damage in an area. The thrown flask Consumes Poison on Hit to cause an acidic burst. This damage is not based on your unarmed damage, so this is not considered an Unarmed Attack
AcidicConcoctionPlayer.name: Acidic Concoction

AlchemistsBoonPlayer.description: While active, grants you Flask charges passively and causes Life and Mana recovery from your Flasks to also apply to Allies in your Presence.
AlchemistsBoonPlayer.name: Alchemist's Boon

AlignFatePlayer.description: While active, visages of yourself from alternate timelines will occasionally appear and cast one of your Spells from your first valid Weapon Set. Until the next visage appears, your next cast of the same Spell aligns your fate, Empowering that Spell. Visages can only cast damaging, non-Channelling, non-Buff Spells you could cast that have no cooldown.
AlignFatePlayer.name: Align Fate

AmazonTriggerElementalSurgePlayer.description: Grants your weapon Surges. Non-Melee Projectile Attacks with that weapon Consume Surges to cause the Projectiles fired to explode at the end of their flight.
AmazonTriggerElementalSurgePlayer.name: Elemental Surge

AncestralCryPlayer.description: Perform a Warcry using Glory gained by Igniting enemies to turn you into an embodiment of Kaom. While embodying Kaom, you Trigger Volcanic Steps while travelling, Melee Strikes and Slams are Ancestrally Boosted, and your Melee Strikes Trigger Volcanic Eruption.
AncestralCryPlayer.name: Ancestral Cry

AncestralCryProjectilePlayer.description: Fire molten Projectiles from the struck enemy, which will land nearby dealing Attack damage in an area.
AncestralCryProjectilePlayer.name: Volcanic Eruption

AncestralCryShockwavePlayer.description: Slam the ground around you, dealing damage to nearby enemies.
AncestralCryShockwavePlayer.name: Volcanic Steps

AncestralSpiritsPlayer.description: This skill is Triggered each time you summon a Totem, summoning an Ancestral Spirit Minion to fight for you. If the Totem dies then the Ancestral Spirit triggered by it's summoning will die too.
AncestralSpiritsPlayer.name: Ancestral Spirits

AncestralWarriorTotemPlayer.description: Consume 3 Endurance Charges to Raise a Totem that conjures spirit warriors. Each warrior uses a socketed Mace Skill once, then disappears. Cannot use Channelling Skills or Skills with Cooldowns.
AncestralWarriorTotemPlayer.name: Ancestral Warrior Totem

AncientGiftsPlayer.description: You are chosen by Azmerian spirits who provide guidance, allowing you to see nearby Ancient Blooms.
AncientGiftsPlayer.name: Wildwood's Gifts

AnimusExchangePlayer.description: Sacrifice a portion of your Life to recover Runic Ward. Runic Ward recovered by this Skill can Overflow.
AnimusExchangePlayer.name: Animus Exchange

ApocalypseColdPlayer.description: Targets an area or an enemy, causing a series of icy hailstones to rain down in an area over a duration.
ApocalypseColdPlayer.name: Hailstorm

ApocalypseFirePlayer.description: Targets an area or an enemy, calling down a massive meteor to strike an area, dealing Fire damage and contributing to your enemies' extinction.
ApocalypseFirePlayer.name: Meteor

ApocalypseLightningPlayer.description: Targets an area or an enemy, causing a rapid buildup of pulsing Lightning damage in an area that culminates in a powerful final Lightning strike.
ApocalypseLightningPlayer.name: Crash Lightning

ApocalypsePlayer.description: Build Glory by Hitting enemies with Elemental damage. When you have maximum Glory, you may become the walking Apocalypse for a duration, Triggering one of multiple powerful Elemental Skills at an interval while this Buff lasts.
ApocalypsePlayer.name: Apocalypse

ApplyTangmazuSwarmAuraPlayer.description: The Flock damages enemies around you.
ApplyTangmazuSwarmAuraPlayer.name: Winged Entropy

ArbitersReachWardPlayer.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you periodically grant Guard to allies in your Presence while the Skill is active.
ArbitersReachWardPlayer.name: Arbiter's Reach

ArcPlayer.description: An arc of Lightning stretches from the caster to a targeted enemy and Chains on to other nearby enemies. Consumes a Lightning Infusion if possible to deal more damage and Chain further.
ArcPlayer.name: Arc

ArcSkeletonMageMinion.description: An arc of Lightning stretches from the caster to a targeted enemy and Chains on to other nearby enemies. Shocked enemies Hit release damaging pulses.
ArcSkeletonMageMinion.name: Arc

ArchmagePlayer.description: While active, causes your Non-Channelling Spells to cost additional mana and deal extra Lightning damage, both based on your maximum Mana.
ArchmagePlayer.name: Archmage

ArchonOfChayulaPlayer.description: Build Glory by dealing Chaos damage to enemies. When you have maximum Glory, you can entreat the Dreamer to inhabit you, briefly becoming his Archon.
ArchonOfChayulaPlayer.name: Archon of Chayula

ArchonOfChayulaTornadoPlayer.description: Conjure a Chaos tornado that chases down and Slows enemies.
ArchonOfChayulaTornadoPlayer.name: Chayula's Will

ArcticArmourPlayer.description: While active, conjures an icy barrier that gains stages over time. While the barrier has stages, Melee Attacks that hit you will remove a stage to cause a burst of ice that deals Cold Spell damage to the attacker.
ArcticArmourPlayer.name: Arctic Armour

ArmourBreakerPlayer.description: Strike with a forceful blow, knocking enemies back and weakening their Armour.
ArmourBreakerPlayer.name: Armour Breaker

ArmourPiercingBoltsAmmoPlayer.description: Load your Crossbow with a clip of bolts that can be fired rapidly and Break enemy Armour. Using this Skill again reloads the clip.
ArmourPiercingBoltsAmmoPlayer.name: Load Armour Piercing Rounds

ArmourPiercingBoltsPlayer.description: Rapidly fire bolts that Break enemy Armour. Can fire a limited number of bolts before needing to reload.
ArmourPiercingBoltsPlayer.name: Armour Piercing Rounds

ArtilleryBallistaPlayer.description: Deploy a Ballista Totem that rains down a salvo of Pinning, Maiming bolts.
ArtilleryBallistaPlayer.name: Artillery Ballista

AttritionPlayer.description: While active, causes you to deal more Hit damage to Rare and Unique enemies the longer you've been fighting them, and gain Culling Strike against them once you've been fighting them for long enough.
AttritionPlayer.name: Attrition

AzmerianSwarmPlayer.description: While active, summons short-lived Azmerian Swarms when you kill enemies affected by Elemental Ailments or hit Rare or Unique enemies affected by Elemental Ailments. The swarms are untargetable Minions that pursue nearby enemies to Attack them and infict Faerie Fire on Hit.
AzmerianSwarmPlayer.name: Azmerian Swarms

BallLightningPlayer.description: Fire a slow-moving Projectile that moves through enemies. The Projectile itself does not Hit enemies, but repeatedly discharges bolts of Lightning at nearby enemies. Consumes a Fire Infusion if possible to slow down over time, create Ignited Ground as it travels, and explode dealing Fire damage in an Area after it dissipates.
BallLightningPlayer.name: Ball Lightning

BarkskinPlayer.description: While active, taking Hit damage from enemies to your Energy Shield causes you to gain Armour for a short duration. Armour gained from multiple Hits can stack. The total Armour gained from this Skill cannot exceed the Item Armour on your Equipped Armour Items.
BarkskinPlayer.name: Barkskin

BarragePlayer.description: Ready a volley of arrows or spears, Empowering your next Repeatable Bow or Projectile Spear Attack to Repeat multiple times. Consumes your Frenzy Charges on use to add additional repeats.
BarragePlayer.name: Barrage

BearFuryOfTheMountainPlayer.description: Shapeshift into a Bear and repeatedly pound the ground, creating Molten Fissures that travel randomly in a wide arc in front of you.
BearFuryOfTheMountainPlayer.name: Fury of the Mountain

BearMaulPlayer.description: Shapeshift into a Bear and rake enemies with your claws, generating Rage on Hit.
BearMaulPlayer.name: Maul

BearRampagePlayer.description: Shapeshift into a Bear and charge forward, Slamming the ground as you run. Channelling ends after a short amount of time but can be prolonged by spending Rage.
BearRampagePlayer.name: Rampage

BerserkPlayer.description: While active, strengthens your Rage, but causes you to lose Life while not losing Rage.
BerserkPlayer.name: Berserk

BitterDeadPlayer.description: Spend Ward and target an area, transforming Corpses into bitter cores that seek out enemies and Chill enemies near them. The cores explode at the end of their duration, creating runes which deal additional Cold damage over time.
BitterDeadPlayer.name: Bitter Dead

BlackPowderBlitzReservationPlayer.description: Replaces your dodge roll with an explosive-assisted leap, firing off a round from your prosthetic cannon leg that Blinds and Ignites enemies in the area you escape from. The explosion will cause any Grenades in its area of effect to also explode.
BlackPowderBlitzReservationPlayer.name: Black Powder Blitz

BlasphemyPlayer.description: Turn socketed Curse skills into vile Auras, applying their effects to all nearby enemies.
BlasphemyPlayer.name: Blasphemy

BleedingConcoctionPlayer.description: Consume charges from your Mana Flask to throw a flask that explodes, dealing Physical Attack damage in an area and Aggravating Bleeding on Enemies hit. This damage is not based on your unarmed damage, so this is not considered an Unarmed Attack
BleedingConcoctionPlayer.name: Bleeding Concoction

BlinkPlayer.description: While active, replaces your dodge roll with a short-cooldown Spell that allows you to tunnel through space, instantly reappearing a medium distance away.
BlinkPlayer.name: Blink

BlinkReservationPlayer.description: While active, replaces your dodge roll with a short-cooldown Spell that allows you to tunnel through space, instantly reappearing a medium distance away.
BlinkReservationPlayer.name: Blink

BloodBoilPlayer.description: Enemies in your Presence accumulate blood boils periodically. When they die, the boils pop applying Corrupted Blood to enemies near them.
BloodBoilPlayer.name: Blood Boil

BloodHuntPlayer.description: Lunge at a target and skewers them. Hitting an enemy that has suffered Blood Loss will cause a blood explosion and also Consume Bleeding. This skill cannot be Ancestrally Boosted.
BloodHuntPlayer.name: Blood Hunt

BloodhoundsMarkExplosionPlayer.description: A violent explosion of blood that deals Physical Attack damage which is not based on your Weapon's damage.
BloodhoundsMarkExplosionPlayer.name: Blood Explosion

BloodhoundsMarkPlayer.description: Mark a target, making them suffer Heavy Stun build up from Blood Loss. The Mark will Activate, Consuming itself to Trigger Blood Explosion, when they are Heavy Stunned, or when they are killed if they suffered enough Blood Loss. The Mark's duration does not expire while the Marked target is suffering Blood Loss.
BloodhoundsMarkPlayer.name: Bloodhound's Mark

BoneBlastPlayer.description: Conjure a circle of ritual inscriptions that last for a short duration. When the duration ends, spikes of bone erupt from enemies in the area, damaging them and potentially causing Bleeding.
BoneBlastPlayer.name: Bone Blast

BoneCagePlayer.description: Raise a ring of bone spikes around you. The spikes are destroyed when enemies touch them, damaging and Pinning those enemies. Raising a new ring of spikes destroys the previous one.
BoneCagePlayer.name: Bone Cage

BoneOfferingPlayer.description: Impale a Skeleton on a bone spike to shield your Minions while the spike remains, reducing the amount of damage taken from Hits. Taking a Hit that deals damage above a certain threshold will cause that Minion's shield to absorb all damage from that Hit, then explode.  The bone spike is itself a Minion, and shields itself. If it dies, shields on your other Minions disappear.
BoneOfferingPlayer.name: Bone Offering

BoneshatterBruteMinion.description: A Strike that causes a Heavy Stun on enemies that are Primed for Stun. Upon causing a Heavy Stun it will also create a Shockwave, dealing a large amount of damage in an area.
BoneshatterBruteMinion.name: Bonebreaker

BoneshatterPlayer.description: Attack enemies with a melee Strike. The Strike will cause a Heavy Stun on enemies that are Primed for Stun. Upon causing a Heavy Stun it will also create a Shockwave, dealing a large amount of damage in an area.
BoneshatterPlayer.name: Boneshatter

BonestormPlayer.description: Channel to conjure a swarm of bone spikes in the air, then release to fire them at enemies and explode. Shrapnel Impales enemies Hit, causing subsequent Attack Hits against those targets to deal extra damage. Consumes your Power Charges to cause much larger explosions.
BonestormPlayer.name: Bonestorm

BriarpatchPlayer.description: While active, a portion of the Physical Attack damage you deal is stored. Casting a Spell uses the stored damage to create a patch of Thorny Ground that deals Spell damage to moving enemies.
BriarpatchPlayer.name: Briarpatch

ChaosFrogExplosionPlayer.description: Explodes a Witchtoad to deal spell damage in an area.
ChaosFrogExplosionPlayer.name: Dark Consequences

ChaosSpearTriggerChaosSurgePlayer.description: Grants your weapon Surges. Non-Melee Projectile Attacks with that weapon Consume Surges to cause the Projectiles fired to explode at the end of their flight.
ChaosSpearTriggerChaosSurgePlayer.name: Chaotic Surge

ChargeRegulationPlayer.description: While active, you gain powerful Buffs based on your active Charges. However, maintaining the Buff Consumes Charges every few seconds.
ChargeRegulationPlayer.name: Charge Regulation

ChargedStaffPlayer.description: Consume all Power Charges to charge your Quarterstaff with electricity, adding Lightning damage and a Lightning shockwave to your Quarterstaff Attacks. Reusing this skill while the Buff is active adds to the Buff's duration and damage.
ChargedStaffPlayer.name: Charged Staff

ChilledGroundBurstWaterDjinn.description: Command Navira to fracture all nearby areas of Chilled Ground that have enemies standing on them, doing high Spell damage with extreme Freeze potential.
ChilledGroundBurstWaterDjinn.name: Navira's Fracturing

ChilledGroundOasisConvertWaterDjinn.description: Command Navira to turn nearby Chilled Ground into Navira's Oasis, a mirage which grants you and Allies standing in it Flask charges and damage Recouped as Life and Mana. Plants in the area become Overgrown.
ChilledGroundOasisConvertWaterDjinn.name: Navira's Oasis

ClusterGrenadePlayer.description: Fire a bouncing Grenade that explodes when its fuse expires, throwing out a ring of mini Grenades that explode when they come to a stop.
ClusterGrenadePlayer.name: Cluster Grenade

CoilingBoltsPlayer.description: Simultaneously fires a Physical Projectile and a Chaos Projectile at the target. These projectiles Chain through any number of Cursed targets.
CoilingBoltsPlayer.name: Coiling Bolts

CombatFrenzyPlayer.description: While active, grants you a Frenzy Charge when you Freeze, Electrocute or Pin an enemy. This can only occur once every few seconds.
CombatFrenzyPlayer.name: Combat Frenzy

CometPlayer.description: Call down a mass of ice from the sky, dealing high damage at the targeted location. Targeting close to you will cause you to jump back as you cast. Consumes a Fire Infusion if possible to cause a devastating blast of ice and fire.
CometPlayer.name: Comet

CompressedDurationSupportPlayer.description: Supports any skill that has a duration making that duration shorter.
CompressedDurationSupportPlayer.name: Compressed Duration I

CompressedDurationSupportPlayerTwo.description: Supports any skill that has a duration making that duration shorter.
CompressedDurationSupportPlayerTwo.name: Compressed Duration II

ConductiveRunesPlayer.description: Spend Runic Ward to create a number of Hazardous Runes in a cone in front of you, which arm after a time. After arming, these Runes will activate when enemies step on them, exploding to deal Attack damage that is not based on your Weapon's damage and apply Electrocution buildup.
ConductiveRunesPlayer.name: Conductive Runes

ContagionPlayer.description: Afflict a single enemy with a Debuff that deals Chaos damage over time. If the enemy dies while affected by Contagion, it spreads itself, Curses, and other Chaos damage over time Debuffs on the target to nearby enemies. This refreshes their durations. Reanimating or detonating a corpse affected by Contagion will cause the Minion or explosion to spread Contagion on hit.
ContagionPlayer.name: Contagion

ConvalescencePlayer.description: While active, grants a skill that you can use to instantly begin Recharging Energy Shield and gain a Buff for a duration that prevents that Recharge being interrupted. The Buff is removed at maximum Energy Shield and the skill cannot be used while Energy Shield is full.
ConvalescencePlayer.name: Convalescence

CorpseBeetlesPlayer.description: Harness Kelari's power to passively Consume Corpses in your Presence, causing Corpse Beetle Minions to burst forth. The Beetles passively follow you until Commanded. On your Command, they rush the target and explode.
CorpseBeetlesPlayer.name: Kelari's Malediction

CorpseCloudPlayer.description: Consume a Corpse to create a cloud of flammable Poisonous gas. Any Burning effects or Detonator skills will explode the gas cloud, creating a fiery explosion.
CorpseCloudPlayer.name: Decompose

CracklingPalmPlayer.description: When you Hit with Unarmed Melee Attacks, calls down lightning bolts which deal Unarmed Attack damage to all surrounding enemies.
CracklingPalmPlayer.name: Crackling Palm

CrossbowRequiemAmmoPlayer.description: Your weapon passively accumulates anguish from the tormented souls within. When fully charged, use this skill to compose the Requiem, transforming your Crossbow shot into a torrent of anguish for a short, fixed amount of time. Does not use Ammunition.
CrossbowRequiemAmmoPlayer.name: Compose Requiem

CrossbowRequiemPlayer.description: Unleashes a torrent of anguish that bombard the target area, dealing damage in an area on impact. Does not use Ammunition and can be fired freely until the Requiem ends.
CrossbowRequiemPlayer.name: Requiem

CrushingFearPlayer.description: Dash to an enemy and Strike them, Culling enemies if their life is low enough. When this skill kills an enemy you draw out their final fears, crushing them to create a shockwave. Enemies around you that can be Culled will be highlighted.
CrushingFearPlayer.name: Crushing Fear

CullTheWeakPlayer.description: Dash to an enemy and run them through, Culling enemies if their life is low enough. If this Attack kills at least one enemy, it grants you a Frenzy Charge, with higher Rarity monsters granting additional Charges. Enemies around you that can be Culled will be highlighted.
CullTheWeakPlayer.name: Cull the Weak

CurseOfRepulsionPlayer.description: Target an area and Curse enemies within with a Verisium Rune, inflicting them with Fragility. Hitting these enemies causes the Curse to Trigger an explosion to deal damage in an area and apply significant Knockback to other enemies near the Cursed target, with more Stun buildup based on the Fragility on the target Hit.
CurseOfRepulsionPlayer.name: Repulsion

CurseOfRepulsionShockwavePlayer.description: Deals Physical Attack damage in an area around the Cursed target that is not based on your Weapon's damage. Other targets are Knocked back and take more Stun buildup based on the Fragility they have.
CurseOfRepulsionShockwavePlayer.name: Repulsion Wave

DarkEffigyPlayer.description: Raise a Totem that bombards enemies afflicted by Chaos damage over time Debuffs.
DarkEffigyPlayer.name: Dark Effigy

DarkEffigyProjectilePlayer.description: Fire a Projectile at every nearby enemy that is afflicted by a Chaos damage over time Debuff. Fires multiple Projectiles at enemies afflicted by multiple Debuffs, but Projectile count cannot be otherwise modified.
DarkEffigyProjectilePlayer.name: Vile Effusion

DeathFromAboveDaemonMinion.description: Fires a flare at a target location, attaching to an enemy if it lands on one, then launches a series of arrow volleys centred around the flare.
DeathFromAboveDaemonMinion.name: Death From Above

DeathStormSkeletonStormMageMinion.description: Lightning bolts strike all fallen Skeletons in the area, creating Shocked Ground around them.
DeathStormSkeletonStormMageMinion.name: Death Storm

DefianceBannerReservationPlayer.description: While active, Attacking enemies builds Glory. When you have maximum Glory, you can place an inspiring Banner for a duration with an Aura that grants you and nearby Allies Armour, Evasion and movement speed.
DefianceBannerReservationPlayer.name: Defiance Banner

DemonFormPlayer.description: Shapeshift into a demon, vastly boosting the power of your Spells. You gain Demonflame every second you remain in demon form, causing your Life to be lost at an ever-increasing rate. Maximum 10 Demonflame. Revert to human form if you reach 1 Life, use a Skill that isn't a Spell, or reactivate this Skill.
DemonFormPlayer.name: Demon Form

DespairPlayer.description: Curse all targets in an area after a short delay, lowering their Chaos Resistance.
DespairPlayer.name: Despair

DestructiveLinkSkeletonBombadierMinion.description: Detonate an allied Minion whose current Life is below a threshold, dealing heavy Attack damage to nearby enemies.
DestructiveLinkSkeletonBombadierMinion.name: Explosive Demise

DetonateDeadPlayer.description: Cause a Corpse to violently explode, damaging surrounding enemies.
DetonateDeadPlayer.name: Detonate Dead

DetonateLivingPlayer.description: Hit an enemy under the Culling Strike Threshold, causing them to violently explode, damaging surrounding enemies. Highlights enemies under the Culling Strike Threshold.
DetonateLivingPlayer.name: Detonate Living

DetonatingArrowPlayer.description: Channel to charge up before firing off a burning arrow. At maximum stages, the arrow will create a Detonating explosion at the end of its flight.
DetonatingArrowPlayer.name: Detonating Arrow

DisciplinePlayer.description: Emit an Aura that grants you and Allies in your Presence additional Total Energy Shield.
DisciplinePlayer.name: Discipline

DisengagePlayer.description: Jump back as you rupture the earth in front of you with spearpoints, damaging enemies. Consumes the Parried Debuff on Hitting enemies to release a shockwave and grant you a Frenzy Charge. This skill can be used while using other skills, and causes Strikes and Projectiles to miss you while jumping. This skill cannot be Ancestrally Boosted.
DisengagePlayer.name: Disengage

DoomBlastPlayer.description: Deal Chaos damage in an area around the previously Cursed enemy.
DoomBlastPlayer.name: Doom Blast

DreadBannerReservationPlayer.description: While active, Attacking enemies builds Glory. When you have maximum Glory, you can place an inspiring Banner for a duration with an Aura that grants you and nearby Allies Elemental Ailment Threshold, Maximum Elemental Resistances and Flask charges.
DreadBannerReservationPlayer.name: Dread Banner

ESRechargeForceRestartWaterDjinn.description: Command Navira to bolster your Energy Shield, causing it to begin Recharging immediately and granting you increased Energy Shield Recharge Rate for a duration.
ESRechargeForceRestartWaterDjinn.name: Navira's Well

EarthquakePlayer.description: Smash the ground, dealing damage in an area and leaving behind Jagged Ground that slows enemies. The Jagged Ground erupts in a powerful Aftershock after a duration. Cannot create Jagged Ground on top of an existing patch, or if you already have the maximum number of active patches.
EarthquakePlayer.name: Earthquake

EarthshatterPlayer.description: Slam the ground, sending out a fissure that deals area damage to enemies it passes under and thrusts a spike from the ground when it ends. Warcries performed near the spike will cause it to shatter, damaging surrounding enemies.
EarthshatterPlayer.name: Earthshatter

ElectrocutingArrowPlayer.description: Fire an electrifying arrow that explodes in an Area on Hit. Hitting an enemy will attach an Electrocuting Rod to them, causing all incoming Lightning damage to build up Electrocution. This rod is removed when the enemy is next Electrocuted.
ElectrocutingArrowPlayer.name: Electrocuting Arrow

ElementalConfluxPlayer.description: Tap into a current of raw and unpredictable Elemental power, causing you to deal greatly more damage of a randomly chosen Element. The Element affected changes frequently, though the same Element can be affected multiple times in succession.
ElementalConfluxPlayer.name: Elemental Conflux

ElementalExpressionTriggeredPlayer.description: Create a fiery explosion, an arcing bolt of lightning, or an icy wave of projectiles. The chance for an explosion is proportional to your Strength, for a bolt proportional to your Dexterity, and for a wave proportional to your Intelligence.
ElementalExpressionTriggeredPlayer.name: Elemental Expression

ElementalStormPlayer.description: Create a stationary Fire, Cold or Lightning storm at a target location for a duration, based on the highest Elemental Damage type for the Hit that Triggered the storm. Hits which do not deal Elemental Damage will not Trigger the storm.
ElementalStormPlayer.name: Elemental Storm

ElementalSunderingPlayer.description: Plunge your Spear into the ground to emit a pulse that Consumes Freeze, Shock and Ignite on a number of nearby enemies, Allies and Corpses. The pulse itself deals no damage, but each Ailment Consumed causes an explosion of the corresponding elemental damage type.
ElementalSunderingPlayer.name: Elemental Sundering

ElementalWeaknessPlayer.description: Curse all targets in an area after a short delay, lowering their Elemental Resistances.
ElementalWeaknessPlayer.name: Elemental Weakness

EmberFusilladePlayer.description: Conjure a blazing Ember that hovers above you. After a short duration, the Ember launches at an enemy, dealing Fire damage in an area on impact and prioritising the last enemy targeted. Recasting this spell resets the duration for all active Embers. Multiple Embers fired in the same Fusillade will attempt to target different enemies. Consumes a Lightning Infusion if possible to cause the entire Fusillade to create beams that Chain to enemies.
EmberFusilladePlayer.name: Ember Fusillade

EmergencyReloadPlayer.description: Instantly reload all your Crossbow Ammunition clips and Empower each clip's Ammunition to deal more damage for a duration.
EmergencyReloadPlayer.name: Emergency Reload

EncaseInJadePlayer.description: Consume all stacks of Jade to grant Guard based off your maximum Life for each Jade consumed. You cannot gain Jade stacks while you have Guard.
EncaseInJadePlayer.name: Encase in Jade

EnervatingNovaPlayer.description: Unleash a Nova of Lightning damage to Electrocute enemies. Enemies close to you take no damage while enemies at the edge of the ring take significantly more damage. Enemies Hit can be Electrocuted by all Lightning damage for a short duration.
EnervatingNovaPlayer.name: Enervating Nova

EnfeeblePlayer.description: Curse all targets in an area after a short delay, making them deal less damage.
EnfeeblePlayer.name: Enfeeble

EnrageSkeletonReaverMinion.description: Enrage all Skeletal Reavers, causing them to lose life over time and gain Rage on hit.
EnrageSkeletonReaverMinion.name: Enrage

EntanglePlayer.description: Conjures a rootbound fissure that crawls forward, damaging enemies in its path. While the fissure persists, vines lash out from it and attach to nearby enemies, damaging and Slowing them.
EntanglePlayer.name: Entangle

EscapeShotPlayer.description: Leap backwards, firing an icy arrow which can Chill or Freeze enemies around the location from which you escaped. This arrow will create Ice Fragments on impact.
EscapeShotPlayer.name: Escape Shot

EssenceDrainPlayer.description: Fire a Projectile that applies a powerful Chaos damage over time debuff to enemies it hits.
EssenceDrainPlayer.name: Essence Drain

EternalMarchPlayer.description: Spend Runic Ward to instantly Revive your Minions. Prioritises the most powerful minions first.
EternalMarchPlayer.name: Eternal March

EternalRagePlayer.description: While active, you constantly regenerate Rage.
EternalRagePlayer.name: Eternal Rage

ExplodingPoisonToadPlayer.description: This skill creates a toad that jumps around briefly, then explodes the toad, dealing Attack damage in an area and inflicting Poison.  Damage you deal with skill is not based on your Weapon
ExplodingPoisonToadPlayer.name: Bursting Fen Toad

ExplosiveConcoctionPlayer.description: Consume charges from your Mana Flask to throw a flask that explodes, dealing Fire Attack damage in an area. Additional smaller flasks are thrown at nearby Ignited Enemies. This damage is not based on your unarmed damage, so this is not considered an Unarmed Attack
ExplosiveConcoctionPlayer.name: Explosive Concoction

ExplosiveGrenadePlayer.description: Fire a bouncing Grenade that unleashes a devastating fiery blast when its fuse expires.
ExplosiveGrenadePlayer.name: Explosive Grenade

ExplosiveShotAmmoPlayer.description: Load your Crossbow with flaming bolts that explode on impact. The explosion will cause any Grenades in its area of effect to also explode.
ExplosiveShotAmmoPlayer.name: Load Explosive Shot

ExplosiveShotPlayer.description: Fire a flaming bolt that explodes on impact. The explosion will cause any Grenades in its area of effect to also explode.
ExplosiveShotPlayer.name: Explosive Shot

ExplosiveSpearPlayer.description: Hurl a single payload Spear that pierces through enemies and lodges in terrain where it lands. The Spear will explode at the end of its Detonation Time or if Detonated. Consumes a Frenzy Charge if you have one to explode immediately, dealing more damage in a cross-shaped area and creating Ignited Ground.
ExplosiveSpearPlayer.name: Explosive Spear

ExplosiveTeleportSandDjinn.description: Command Kelari to create a blast at the target location that deals Spell damage, and leave behind a clone that persists for a short duration. This skill can store multiple charges, and using it again while a clone from a previous use is still alive causes that clone to explode, dealing even more damage.
ExplosiveTeleportSandDjinn.name: Kelari's Deception

ExplosiveTransmutationPlayer.description: While active, picking up Remnants Triggers a deadly explosion, dealing damage at the location of the Remnant based on the type of Remnant picked up.
ExplosiveTransmutationPlayer.name: Explosive Transmutation

ExsanguinatePlayer.description: Expel your own blood as Chaining blood tendrils in a cone in front of you. Enemies Hit by the tendrils take Physical damage and are inflicted with Bleeding.
ExsanguinatePlayer.name: Exsanguinate

EyeOfWinterPlayer.description: Fire a single Eye Projectile which does not Hit enemies. The Eye constantly releases damaging shard Projectiles in a spiral as it flies. If the Eye passes over an Elemental Ground Surface or Orb, it will take on that surface's effect causing shards to deal more damage of the corresponding Type.
EyeOfWinterPlayer.name: Eye of Winter

FallingThunderPlayer.description: Suffuse your Quarterstaff with electrical energy, then Slam the ground to deal damage in a large cone in front of you. Consumes your Power Charges to fire Lightning Projectiles forwards from the impact.
FallingThunderPlayer.name: Falling Thunder

FangsOfFrostPlayer.description: Perform an icy stab that exploits enemies who are already off balance. Hitting a Parried target Consumes the Debuff to cause an explosion of frost and leave Chilled Ground.
FangsOfFrostPlayer.name: Fangs of Frost

FeastOfFleshPlayer.description: Consume Corpses near you to recover Life and Mana over a short time per Corpse Consumed.
FeastOfFleshPlayer.name: Feast of Flesh

FerociousRoarMetaPlayer.description: Shapeshift into a Bear and roar in defiance, immediately gaining Rage if there are enemies nearby and Empowering subsequent Attacks to Break Armour. Alternatively, socketing a human-form Warcry into this Skill triggers that Warcry instead, and augments its damage and area. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending an Endurance Charge.
FerociousRoarMetaPlayer.name: Ferocious Roar

FireBombSkeletonMinion.description: Attacks with a bouncing bomb that explodes on hit.
FireBombSkeletonMinion.name: Fire Bomb

FireRuneFireDjinn.description: Command Ruzhan to hurl his greatsword, spreading hazardous runes on the ground where it lands. If an enemy steps on a rune, it erupts in a fiery tornado that deals Spell damage.
FireRuneFireDjinn.name: Ruzhan's Trap

FireballPlayer.description: Launch a large ball of Fire which explodes on impact. The explosion Consumes a Fire Infusion if possible to launch a ring of smaller firebolts.
FireballPlayer.name: Fireball

FireboltPlayer.description: Launch a fiery Projectile towards a target. The Projectile explodes on impact, damaging foes in a small area.
FireboltPlayer.name: Firebolt

FirestormPlayer.description: Rain a storm of flaming bolts over the targeted area. Can Consume all three types of Elemental Infusion, creating a much larger storm when Fire-Infused, causing lightning bolts when Lightning-Infused, and raining ice bolts when Cold-Infused.
FirestormPlayer.name: Firestorm

FistOfWarSupportPlayer.description: Supports Slams you use yourself, providing a powerful Ancestral Boost every few seconds.
FistOfWarSupportPlayer.name: Fist of War I

FistOfWarSupportPlayerThree.description: Supports Slams you use yourself, providing a very powerful Ancestral Boost infrequently.
FistOfWarSupportPlayerThree.name: Fist of War III

FistOfWarSupportPlayerTwo.description: Supports Slams you use yourself, providing a powerful Ancestral Boost every few seconds.
FistOfWarSupportPlayerTwo.name: Fist of War II

FlameSliceFireDjinn.description: When you use a damaging Skill, Ruzhan emerges to Strike enemies near your target with zealous fervour, inflicting Exposure.
FlameSliceFireDjinn.name: Ruzhan's Zealotry

FlameWallPlayer.description: Create a wall of Fire in front of you, which Ignites everything within its area. Any Projectiles fired through the wall by you and Allies deal added Fire damage. Consumes a Lightning Infusion if possible to also add Lightning damage to the Projectiles.
FlameWallPlayer.name: Flame Wall

FlameblastPlayer.description: Channel to build destructive energy around you. Releasing the energy causes a devastating explosion that is larger and more intense the longer you Channelled for.
FlameblastPlayer.name: Flameblast

FlashGrenadePlayer.description: Fire a bouncing Grenade that unleashes a Blinding, Stunning explosion when its fuse expires.
FlashGrenadePlayer.name: Flash Grenade

FlickerStrikePlayer.description: Teleport to a enemy and Strike them. Consumes Power Charges to perform additional teleporting Strikes on nearby enemies.
FlickerStrikePlayer.name: Flicker Strike

ForgeHammerPlayer.description: Hurl a fiery hammer that Slams into the ground and lodges there. While the hammer is lodged in the ground, reusing this Skill recalls the hammer and resets the Skill's cooldown. Alternatively, using a Warcry near the lodged hammer causes it to shatter, releasing a number of Molten Fissures in a spiral.
ForgeHammerPlayer.name: Forge Hammer

FortifyingCryPlayer.description: Perform a Warcry that grants Guard and Triggers Shield Wave when subsequent Shield Attacks deal damage. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending an Endurance Charge.
FortifyingCryPlayer.name: Fortifying Cry

FragmentationRoundsAmmoPlayer.description: Load your Crossbow with Piercing bolts that fragment in flight. Bolts that hit a Frozen enemy Consume the Freeze and cause an explosion of shrapnel. Bolts that hit an Ice Crystal cause it to explode. These fragments can Merge.
FragmentationRoundsAmmoPlayer.name: Load Fragmentation Rounds

FragmentationRoundsPlayer.description: Fire Piercing bolts that fragment in flight. Bolts that hit a Frozen enemy Consume the Freeze and cause an explosion of ice shards. These fragments can Merge.
FragmentationRoundsPlayer.name: Fragmentation Rounds

FragmentsOfThePastPlayer.description: Spend Runic Ward to create a Verisium volcano that deals damage on initial eruption and Triggers Ice Fragments.
FragmentsOfThePastPlayer.name: Fragments of the Past

FreezingMarkPlayer.description: Mark a target, making them more susceptible to being Frozen. When the Marked target is Frozen, the Mark Activates, granting you a Buff which gives extra Cold damage and Consuming the Mark. Marking another target while you have the Buff will remove the Buff.
FreezingMarkPlayer.name: Freezing Mark

FreezingSalvoPlayer.description: Passively gains Seals over time. Using the skill fires a projectile, and breaks the Seals, Repeating for each of them, and for each additional projectile the skill is given. For each time it Repeats normally, it will also Repeat an additional time targeting a different Ice Fragment in its area of effect if able, Detonating those Ice Fragments immediately.
FreezingSalvoPlayer.name: Freezing Salvo

FreezingShardsPlayer.description: Launch icy Projectiles in a sweeping arc. Multiple Projectiles can hit the same enemy.
FreezingShardsPlayer.name: Freezing Shards

FrostBombPlayer.description: Create a pulsing Orb of frost. Each pulse inflicts Elemental Exposure on nearby enemies. When the Orb's duration ends, it Detonates, dealing Cold damage to surrounding enemies and leaving behind a Cold Infusion.
FrostBombPlayer.name: Frost Bomb

FrostDartsPlayer.description: Conjures a number of icy Projectiles that launch towards the target. Projectiles that Hit a Chilled or Frozen target create chunks of ice that deal additional damage on impacting the ground. Consumes a Cold Infusion if possible to cause each Projectile to lodge into the enemy then explode.
FrostDartsPlayer.name: Frost Darts

FrostWallPlayer.description: Create a wall of Ice Crystals which holds back enemies. The Crystals explode if sufficiently damaged, or if pushed hard enough, damaging nearby enemies. Consumes a Lightning Infusion if possible to add another Lightning explosion if destroyed.
FrostWallPlayer.name: Frost Wall

FrostboltPlayer.description: Fire a slow-moving Piercing Projectile that is effective at Chilling enemies and explodes on colliding with terrain.
FrostboltPlayer.name: Frostbolt

FrostflameNovaPlayer.description: Unleash a wave of volatile ice that feeds on flames. While the wave doesn't deal damage, the ice latches onto Ignited enemies, refreshing the duration of their active Ignite and rapidly Freezing them but preventing them from being Ignited further until the Ignite expires.
FrostflameNovaPlayer.name: Frostflame Nova

FrozenLocusPlayer.description: Leap backward and crack the ground with your staff to call forth an Ice Crystal which can be damaged by you and enemies. If the Crystal is destroyed it causes an icy explosion. This skill can be used while using other skills.
FrozenLocusPlayer.name: Frozen Locus

FulminatingConcoctionPlayer.description: Consume charges from your Mana Flask to throw a flask that explodes, dealing Lightning Attack damage in an area with high chance to Shock. This damage is not based on your unarmed damage, so this is not considered an Unarmed Attack
FulminatingConcoctionPlayer.name: Fulminating Concoction

FulminationPlayer.description: While active, the first time any Skill Hits a Shocked enemy in your Presence, that Skill also Hits other Shocked enemies in your Presence, up to a maximum.
FulminationPlayer.name: Fulmination

FuriousSlamPlayer.description: Shapeshift into a Bear and Slam the ground with great force, causing a pair of shockwaves. Can spend Rage to create larger shockwaves that leave behind Jagged Ground.
FuriousSlamPlayer.name: Furious Slam

FuturePastPlayer.description: Hinekora observes your Future-Past granting you the opportunity to subvert a lesser fate. After a period of Hindsight, she will grant you her Foresight, which prevents you from avoiding Hits while Dodge Rolling. When you are Hit while Dodge Rolling, Hinekora restores you to full Life immediately before taking damage from the Hit, and grants you Sight Beyond Sight, which prevents you from dying.
FuturePastPlayer.name: Future-Past

GaleStrikePlayer.description: Batter enemies at range by generating a gust of wind as you swing. Enemies will be Dazed and Knocked Back based on how close they are to you.
GaleStrikePlayer.name: Wind Blast

GalvanicFieldBuffPlayer.description: Gain a Buff that boosts your Shock chance. Shocking an enemy consumes the Buff to attach an Orb of electricity to that enemy. The Orb fires bolts of electricity at nearby enemies until it expires.
GalvanicFieldBuffPlayer.name: Galvanic Field

GalvanicShardsAmmoPlayer.description: Load your Crossbow with charged bolts that fragment in flight, releasing Chaining Lightning beams when they Hit enemies. These fragments can Merge.
GalvanicShardsAmmoPlayer.name: Load Galvanic Shards

GalvanicShardsPlayer.description: Rapidly fire charged bolts that fragment in flight, releasing Chaining Lightning beams when they Hit enemies. Can fire a limited number of bursts before needing to reload. These fragments can Merge.
GalvanicShardsPlayer.name: Galvanic Shards

GasArrowPlayer.description: Fire a noxious arrow at the ground, creating a cloud of flammable poisonous gas at the end of its flight. The cloud will detonate if hit by a Detonator skill or if an Ignited enemy touches it, creating a fiery explosion.
GasArrowPlayer.name: Gas Arrow

GasShotSkeletonSniperMinion.description: Rain an arrow down from above, creating a cloud of flammable poisonous gas where it lands. The cloud will detonate if hit by a Detonator skill or if an Ignited enemy touches it, creating a fiery explosion.
GasShotSkeletonSniperMinion.name: Gas Arrow

GatheringStormPlayer.description: Flip backward and Channel to charge your Quarterstaff with Lightning. Releasing dashes towards the target location, damaging enemies along the way. Releasing with Perfect Timing performs a Lightning-assisted dash that releases shockwaves from enemies you dash through. Perfectly Timed dash also explodes Tempest Bells on hit creating a shockwave that deals more damage and has a larger area, leaving Shocked Ground in its wake. This skill cannot be Ancestrally Boosted.
GatheringStormPlayer.name: Gathering Storm

GelidPalmPlayer.description: When you Hit with Unarmed Melee Attacks, projects icy wind which deal Unarmed Attack damage to all surrounding enemies and destroy Ice Crystals.
GelidPalmPlayer.name: Gelid Palm

GeminiSurgePlayer.description: Grants your weapon Surges. Non-Melee Projectile Attacks with that weapon Consume Surges to cause the Projectiles fired to explode at the end of their flight.
GeminiSurgePlayer.name: Gemini Surge

GhostDancePlayer.description: While active, causes you to periodically gain Ghost Shrouds. If you are Hit while you have a Ghost Shroud, it is immediately consumed to recover Energy Shield based on your Evasion.
GhostDancePlayer.name: Ghost Dance

GlacialBoltAmmoPlayer.description: Load your Crossbow with icy bolts that create two walls of Ice Crystals at the end of their flight.
GlacialBoltAmmoPlayer.name: Load Glacial Bolt

GlacialBoltPlayer.description: Fire an icy bolt that creates two walls of Ice Crystals at the end of its flight.
GlacialBoltPlayer.name: Glacial Bolt

GlacialCascadePlayer.description: Sweep your Quarterstaff upwards, releasing an icy fissure which deals damage in a series of bursts culminating in a large spike. Frozen enemies hit by the final spike are dealt heavy damage but the Freeze is Consumed. Ice Crystals hit by the final spike explode.
GlacialCascadePlayer.name: Glacial Cascade

GlacialLancePlayer.description: Throw a single Piercing lance that leaves icy fragments in its wake. The fragments Chill nearby enemies. Consumes a Frenzy Charge if possible to cause the glacial fragments created by the first Projectile to explode outwards after a short duration, peppering enemies with shrapnel.
GlacialLancePlayer.name: Glacial Lance

GreatHuntPackleaderMinion.description: The Azmerian Wolf howls, reaching out to the spirits to begin an Eternal Hunt. While the Eternal Hunt persists, spirits manifest as spectral wolves to ambush foes, damaging and Maiming enemies they Hit before disappearing.
GreatHuntPackleaderMinion.name: Eternal Hunt

GrimFeastPlayer.description: While active, your Reviving Minions store a percentage of their maximum Life in a collectible Grim Remnant on death. Using Grim Resurrection Consumes the Life you've collected to Revive up to that much total Life of dead Minions.
GrimFeastPlayer.name: Grim Feast

GrimFeastResummonPlayer.description: Consume stored Minion Life to Revive your Minions. Revives as many Minions as possible with total maximum Life equal to or less than the Life stored by Grim Feast, prioritising those with higher maximum Life.
GrimFeastResummonPlayer.name: Grim Resurrection

GrimPillarsPlayer.description: Spend Runic Ward to cause damaging Ice-Crystal spears to erupt from the ground around you. These spears can be destroyed for an explosion of Cold damage.
GrimPillarsPlayer.name: Grim Pillars

HailstormRoundsAmmoPlayer.description: Passively generate bolts of ice at a frequency equal to reload time, up to a cap. Activate to Load the accumulated bolts into your Crossbow. All loaded bolts are fired at once, causing them to rain down over the target area.
HailstormRoundsAmmoPlayer.name: Load Hailstorm Rounds

HailstormRoundsPlayer.description: Fire all loaded bolts into the sky, causing them to rain down over the target area, starting at the centre and spreading outward.
HailstormRoundsPlayer.name: Hailstorm Rounds

HammerOfTheGodsPlayer.description: Build Glory by Heavy Stunning enemies. When you have maximum Glory you may entreat the Ancestors to crush your enemies, manifesting a massive hammer that falls from the sky onto your target, Slamming into the ground after a short duration and dealing immense damage based on your weapon.
HammerOfTheGodsPlayer.name: Hammer of the Gods

HandOfChayulaPlayer.description: Dash to an enemy and Strike them, triggering socketed Marks with increased effect and applying socketed Curses with increased duration.
HandOfChayulaPlayer.name: Hand of Chayula

HandSlamSandDjinn.description: Channel and Command Kelari to Channel alongside you, creating blades that hang over the target location. The longer you Channel, the more blades Kelari will create. Upon release, his blades plunge into the ground and create shockwaves that deal Spell damage.
HandSlamSandDjinn.name: Kelari's Judgment

HarbingerOfMadnessPlayer.description: Draws out the latent fears of enemies you kill and Rare or Unique enemies you Hit, turning them into unstable apparitions which charge towards enemies and then explode.
HarbingerOfMadnessPlayer.name: Harbinger of Madness

HeartOfIcePlayer.description: Chills all enemies in your Presence.
HeartOfIcePlayer.name: Heart of Ice

HeraldOfAshPlayer.description: While active, enemies you sufficiently Overkill with non-Herald Attacks will cause an explosion that Ignites nearby enemies based on the Overkill damage dealt.
HeraldOfAshPlayer.name: Herald of Ash

HeraldOfBloodPlayer.description: While active, killing an enemy with Blood Loss will cause a bloody explosion that deals Physical Attack damage to surrounding enemies. This damage is not based on your Weapon, but is partially based on their accumulated Blood Loss. The explosion destroys their Corpse if the enemy was Normal or Magic, and has a chance to Aggravate Bleeding.
HeraldOfBloodPlayer.name: Herald of Blood

HeraldOfIcePlayer.description: While active, Shattering an enemy with a non-Herald Attack Hit will cause an icy explosion that deals Attack damage to surrounding enemies.
HeraldOfIcePlayer.name: Herald of Ice

HeraldOfPlaguePlayer.description: While active, killing a Poisoned enemy spreads its Poison to other nearby enemies, and has a chance to also Hinder them.
HeraldOfPlaguePlayer.name: Herald of Plague

HeraldOfThunderPlayer.description: While active, killing Shocked enemies with a non-Herald Attack Hit will cause subsequent Attack Hits to release lightning bolts which deals Attack damage to all surrounding enemies.
HeraldOfThunderPlayer.name: Herald of Thunder

HexblastPlayer.description: Detonate a Curse on every enemy in an area, causing explosions of Chaos damage but removing the Curse. Can only detonate Curses for which at least half of the duration has expired.
HexblastPlayer.name: Hexblast

HighVelocityRoundsAmmoPlayer.description: Load your Crossbow with Piercing bolts that apply Riven Armour to enemies with Fully Broken Armour, causing any Hits against those enemies to deal extra damage.
HighVelocityRoundsAmmoPlayer.name: Load High Velocity Rounds

HighVelocityRoundsPlayer.description: Fire a powerful Piercing bolt that applies Riven Armour to enemies with Fully Broken Armour, causing any Hits against those enemies to deal extra damage.
HighVelocityRoundsPlayer.name: High Velocity Rounds

HisFoulEmergencePlayer.description: Conjure a horrific skull rising from the lightless depths to bite your enemies dealing high damage at target location and leaving Withering Ground in its wake. Targeting close to you will cause you to jump back as you cast.
HisFoulEmergencePlayer.name: His Foul Emergence

HisWinnowingFlamePlayer.description: Conjure an abyssal scythe that sweeps across the targeted area, dealing Fire damage to enemies and Consuming Ignite to create pillars of flame. Cannot be Triggered.
HisWinnowingFlamePlayer.name: His Winnowing Flame

HollowFocusPlayer.description: While active, ethereal bells periodically appear near you. Your Hits immediately destroy the bells, creating a shockwave that damages nearby enemies and causes a Heavy Stun on enemies that are Primed for Stun. The bells are themselves always Primed for Stun, they can be Culled, and Hits against them are always Critical Hits.
HollowFocusPlayer.name: Hollow Focus

HollowResonancePlayer.description: Attaches an ethereal bell to your back. Critical Hits with other Skills will cause the bell to ring out, damaging nearby enemies.
HollowResonancePlayer.name: Hollow Resonance

HollowShellPlayer.description: Sacrifice your Runic Ward to send out an energy pulse that grants nearby Allies Guard.
HollowShellPlayer.name: Hollow Shell

HyenaCacklePlayer.description: Activate to summon a cackle of Hyena Companions. The cackle is treated as a single Companion for effects that count or limit Companions, regardless of the number of Hyenas in the cackle. Hyenas whoop when they first appear, Hindering nearby enemies, and have a chance to Maim enemies they Hit.
HyenaCacklePlayer.name: Cackling Companions

IceArmourSkeletonMageMinion.description: Command a Skeletal Frost Mage to target a location or Minion and apply Ice Armour to Minions in an area, reducing damage taken from Hits, causing damage to enemies that Hit them, and counting as Frozen for other effects.
IceArmourSkeletonMageMinion.name: Ice Armour

IceNovaPlayer.description: Conjure a wave of ice in all directions, Knocking Back enemies based on how close they are to you. Casting Ice Nova targeting near a Frostbolt Projectile will cause it to originate from the Frostbolt instead of you. Consumes a Cold Infusion if possible to leave a patch of Chilled Ground.
IceNovaPlayer.name: Ice Nova

IceShardsAmmoPlayer.description: Load your Crossbow with a clip of icy bolts that rapidly fire at the ground, leaving a shard of ice at the impact location that arms after a duration. After arming, the ice shards explode when enemies step on them, dealing more damage the longer they have been armed, up to a maximum. Using this Skill again reloads the clip.
IceShardsAmmoPlayer.name: Load Ice Shards

IceShardsPlayer.description: Rapidly fire icy bolts at the ground, leaving a shard of ice at the impact location that arms after a duration. After arming, the ice shards explode when enemies step on them, dealing more damage the longer they have been armed, up to a maximum. Can fire a limited number of bolts before needing to reload.
IceShardsPlayer.name: Ice Shards

IceShotPlayer.description: Fire an icy arrow that sprays a cone of ice shards when it hits a target.
IceShotPlayer.name: Ice Shot

IceStrikePlayer.description: Perform a fast icy Strike. Using this Attack three times in quick succession causes a final strike that is slower and more powerful.
IceStrikePlayer.name: Ice Strike

IceTippedArrowsPlayer.description: Ready your active Bow or Spear, Empowering your next Repeatable Bow or Projectile Spear Attacks to Convert Physical Damage to Cold Damage and Trigger Ice Fragments on Hit. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Frenzy Charge. Cannot Empower Sustained Skills.
IceTippedArrowsPlayer.name: Ice-Tipped Arrows

IcestormPlayer.description: Conjure a hail of icy bolts over the targeted area. Chill and Freeze on enemies in front of you are Consumed to fuel the Icestorm by creating improved bolts.
IcestormPlayer.name: Icestorm

ImpactShockwaveSupportPlayer.description: Supports Melee Strike Skills and Wind Attack Skills, causing them to create an Aftershock that damages enemies around the target when they Heavy Stun an enemy.
ImpactShockwaveSupportPlayer.name: Impact Shockwave

ImpurityPlayer.description: Emit an Aura that boosts the Chaos Resistance of you and Allies in your Presence.
ImpurityPlayer.name: Impurity

IncendiaryShotAmmoPlayer.description: Load your Crossbow with flaming bolts that fragment in flight, damaging and Igniting enemies on hit and in a small cone behind their final target. These fragments can Merge.
IncendiaryShotAmmoPlayer.name: Load Incendiary Shot

IncendiaryShotPlayer.description: Fire flaming bolts that fragment in flight, damaging and Igniting enemies on hit, and in a small cone behind their final target. These fragments can Merge.
IncendiaryShotPlayer.name: Incendiary Shot

IncineratePlayer.description: Gain fuel by spending Mana on any Skill, then use the accumulated fuel to conjure a torrent of Fire from your hand, Igniting enemies in front of you. The flames grow stronger the longer you Channel. Consumes a Fire Infusion if possible to also create Ignited Ground. Cannot gain fuel while using this skill.
IncineratePlayer.name: Incinerate

InevitableAgonyPlayer.description: Debuff all targets in an area, causing a portion of Damage they take from Hits to be tracked by the Debuff. When the debuff's duration expires or can kill the target, the target loses life equal to that tracked damage all at once.
InevitableAgonyPlayer.name: Inevitable Agony

InfernalCryCorpseExplosionPlayer.description: The enemy's Corpse violently explodes, dealing Fire damage in an area around it.
InfernalCryCorpseExplosionPlayer.name: Combust

InfernalCryPlayer.description: Perform a Warcry, Empowering subsequent Melee Attacks if there are enemies nearby. Enemies in the warcry's area are destabilised and will Combust on death. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending an Endurance Charge.
InfernalCryPlayer.name: Infernal Cry

IntoTheBreachPlayer.description: Create a Breach around you, allowing you to see nearby Flames of Chayula. You are considered to be in a Breach while this skill is active.
IntoTheBreachPlayer.name: Into the Breach

IronWardPlayer.description: While active, stores a percentage of the Physical damage that is prevented by your Armour or other sources of damage reduction. Using this Skill releases the stored damage as a nova of spikes.
IronWardPlayer.name: Iron Ward

KillingPalmPlayer.description: Dash to an enemy and Strike them, Culling enemies if their life is low enough and performing additional dashing Strikes to other Cullable targets in range if your target was Culled. Each enemy killed by this strike grants a Power Charge, with higher Rarity monsters granting additional Charges. Enemies around you that can be Culled will be highlighted.
KillingPalmPlayer.name: Killing Palm

KnifeThrowSandDjinn.description: Command Kelari to throw a volley of knives at the target location. The knives burrow into the ground, then erupt into the air after a short delay, dealing Spell damage.
KnifeThrowSandDjinn.name: Kelari's Brutality

LeapSlamPlayer.description:
Jump into the air, damaging and Knocking Back enemies with your mace where you land. Enemies you would land on are
pushed out of the way.
LeapSlamPlayer.name: Leap Slam

LeylinesPlayer.description: While active, areas of intense runic energy are revealed to you. Standing over them grants you a powerful Spell damage boost but constantly drains your Runic Ward. Running out of Runic Ward causes the energy to temporarily dissipate.
LeylinesPlayer.name: Leylines

LifeRemnantsPlayer.description: Drink the blood of your enemies to restore your Life. While active, enemies you kill have a chance to spawn a Life Remnant, and Hitting a target spawns a Life Remnant every few seconds. Picking up a Life Remnant grants you Life which can Overflow maximum Life.
LifeRemnantsPlayer.name: Life Remnants

LightningArrowPlayer.description: Fire a charged arrow at the target. On hitting an enemy or wall, the arrow will fire Chaining Lightning beams at nearby enemies.
LightningArrowPlayer.name: Lightning Arrow

LightningBoltPlayer.description: Call down a Shocking bolt of Lightning to strike enemies in a small area.
LightningBoltPlayer.name: Lightning Bolt

LightningConduitPlayer.description: Call down Lightning to hit all enemies in a cone in front of you, dealing significantly more damage to Shocked enemies. If there is a Shocked enemy in the target area, additional lightning bolts are distributed among the targets hit. Targeting close to you will cause you to jump back as you cast.
LightningConduitPlayer.name: Lightning Conduit

LightningRodPlayer.description: Fire an arrow that drops from above, creating a Lightning burst. The arrow remains in the ground, and any Chaining Lightning beams can Chain to it. When Chained to, the arrows charge up for a brief period before releasing another Lightning burst. The Lightning Arrow Skill reduces this delay, causing bursts to happen more quickly.
LightningRodPlayer.name: Lightning Rod

LightningSpearPlayer.description: Throw a single copy of your spear. When it hits an enemy it bursts, firing secondary lightning bolt Projectiles at multiple other enemies within a large area around it. Consumes a Frenzy Charge if possible to cause the main spear to split into multiple copies on impact, each of which then bursts.
LightningSpearPlayer.name: Lightning Spear

LightningWarpPlayer.description: Target an enemy to either teleport inside the target's body if they are under the Cull threshold, causing it to violently explode, or to apply a Debuff to them, which will cause the same effect if that enemy falls under the Cull threshold during its duration. Can also be used on Ball Lightning Projectiles. On teleport, the target is destroyed, and the explosion deals Lightning damage to surrounding enemies. If targeting an enemy, the explosion also creates Shocked Ground. Creates a Lightning Infusion on successful use. Highlights enemies that can be Culled.
LightningWarpPlayer.name: Lightning Warp

LingeringIllusionPlayer.description: While active, creates a short-lived illusory copy of yourself whenever you dodge roll. The copy can be damaged by enemies, and copies that are destroyed by an enemy will drop a Remnant that grants you a Power Charge on pickup.
LingeringIllusionPlayer.name: Lingering Illusion

LivingBombFireDjinn.description: Command Ruzhan to place a fiery brand on an enemy. After a delay or when Detonated, the brand explodes, dealing Spell damage to enemies caught in the blast.
LivingBombFireDjinn.name: Ruzhan's Brand

LivingBombPlayer.description: Plant a seed of Fire inside an enemy. Dealing enough damage to the enemy, or killing it outright, causes the seed to explode, dealing damage in an area and leaving behind a Fire Infusion Remnant.
LivingBombPlayer.name: Living Bomb

LivingLightningZap.description: Teleport to a target, dealing Lightning Attack Damage.
LivingLightningZap.name: Zap

LunarAssaultPlayer.description: Shapeshift into a Werewolf and swipe with your claws, projecting an arc of moonlight and ice forward in a crescent.
LunarAssaultPlayer.name: Lunar Assault

MagmaBarrierPlayer.description: While active, increases your Block Chance passively and imbues your Shield with lava over time. When fully imbued, your next Block with your Shield raised will expend the lava to Trigger the Magma Spray skill and grant you an Endurance Charge.
MagmaBarrierPlayer.name: Magma Barrier

MagneticSalvoPlayer.description: Aim skyward and fire energy missiles at lingering bolts or arrows created by other Lightning Attacks in front of you. The missiles explode if they land close to a lingering bolt or arrow, dealing more damage in a larger area but destroying that bolt or arrow in the process.
MagneticSalvoPlayer.name: Magnetic Salvo

MalicePlayer.description: While active, emits an Aura that continuously inflicts Critical Weakness on enemies in your Presence.
MalicePlayer.name: Malice

ManaDrainPlayer.description: Leech Mana from an enemy over a prolonged period, as well as briefly Hindering them.
ManaDrainPlayer.name: Mana Drain

ManaRemnantsPlayer.description: Conjure surging arcane energy to restore your Mana. While active, enemies you kill affected by Elemental Ailments have a chance to spawn a Mana Remnant, and Critically Hitting a target with Elemental Ailments spawns a Mana Remnant every few seconds. Picking up a Mana Remnant grants you Mana which can Overflow maximum Mana.
ManaRemnantsPlayer.name: Mana Remnants

ManaTempestPlayer.description: Create a storm of arcane energies that Empowers your Mana-costing Spells while you remain inside it. Maintaining the storm constantly drains your Mana, and spending more causes it to drain faster. The storm will dissipate when you exit it or run out of Mana.
ManaTempestPlayer.name: Mana Tempest

ManifestWeaponPlayer.description: Manifest a copy of your main hand Melee Martial Weapon as an immortal Companion to fight by your side. In addition to its standard Strikes, the Manifested Weapon gains an additional Attack depending on its weapon type.
ManifestWeaponPlayer.name: Manifest Weapon

MantraOfDestructionPlayer.description:
Build Combo by successfully Striking Enemies with other skills. After reaching maximum Combo, use this skill to Empower your next Quarterstaff Attack, causing it to deal additional Chaos damage. Each kill with the Empowered Attack grants
Purple Flames of Chayula for a duration.
MantraOfDestructionPlayer.name: Mantra of Destruction

MassFusilladeFireDjinn.description: Command Ruzhan to conjure two volleys of flaming embers and fire them forward. The embers explode on impact, dealing Spell damage.
MassFusilladeFireDjinn.name: Ruzhan's Fury

MeditatePlayer.description: Channel to Recharge Energy Shield and allow that Recharge to Overflow. Channelling ends when you take damage or your Energy Shield is fully Overflowed.
MeditatePlayer.name: Meditate

MeleeBowPlayer.description: Fire an arrow with your Bow.
MeleeBowPlayer.name: Bow Shot

MeleeCrossbowPlayer.description: Fire a bolt from your crossbow.
MeleeCrossbowPlayer.name: Crossbow Shot

MeleeGrenadeLauncherPlayer.description: Fire a bouncing Grenade that unleashes a shrapnel blast when its fuse expires.
MeleeGrenadeLauncherPlayer.name: Grenade

MetaAnimusSplintersPlayer.description: Expend a large amount of Runic Ward to instantly create a short-lived copy of yourself that uses a Socketed Skill once, then vanishes. This Skill's cost is equal to the total cost of Socketed Skills. The copy cannot perform Channelled, Remote, Cooldown or Conditional Skills, or summon Minions.
MetaAnimusSplintersPlayer.name: Animus Splinters

MetaBarrierInvocationPlayer.description: While active, gains Energy when your Energy Shield is damaged by Enemy Hits. Using the Invocation once sufficient Energy is gathered will consume the Energy to trigger socketed Spells, and can trigger them multiple times if it has enough Energy.
MetaBarrierInvocationPlayer.name: Barrier Invocation

MetaCastCurseOnBlockPlayer.description: While active, gains Energy when you Block and triggers socketed Curses on reaching maximum Energy.
MetaCastCurseOnBlockPlayer.name: Curse on Block

MetaCastFireSpellOnHitPlayer.description: While active, gains Energy when you Hit enemies with Melee Attacks and triggers socketed Fire spells on reaching maximum Energy.
MetaCastFireSpellOnHitPlayer.name: Fire Spell on Melee Hit

MetaCastLightningSpellOnHitPlayer.description: While active, gains Energy when you Hit enemies with Melee Attacks and triggers socketed Lightning spells on reaching maximum Energy.
MetaCastLightningSpellOnHitPlayer.name: Thundergod's Wrath

MetaCastOnBlockPlayer.description: While active, gains Energy when you Block and triggers socketed Spells on reaching maximum Energy.
MetaCastOnBlockPlayer.name: Cast on Block

MetaCastOnCharmUsePlayer.description: While active, gains Energy when one of your Charms is used and triggers socketed Spells on reaching maximum Energy.
MetaCastOnCharmUsePlayer.name: Cast on Charm Use

MetaCastOnCritPlayer.description: While active, gains Energy when you Critically Hit enemies and triggers socketed Spells on reaching maximum Energy.
MetaCastOnCritPlayer.name: Cast on Critical

MetaCastOnDodgePlayer.description: While active, gains Energy when you dodge roll and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.
MetaCastOnDodgePlayer.name: Cast on Dodge

MetaCastOnElementalAilmentPlayer.description: While active, gains Energy when you Freeze, Shock, or Ignite enemies, and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.
MetaCastOnElementalAilmentPlayer.name: Cast on Elemental Ailment

MetaCastOnMeleeKillPlayer.description: While active, gains Energy when you kill enemies with Melee Attacks and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.
MetaCastOnMeleeKillPlayer.name: Cast on Melee Kill

MetaCastOnMeleeStunPlayer.description: While active, gains Energy when you Stun enemies with Melee Attacks and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.
MetaCastOnMeleeStunPlayer.name: Cast on Melee Stun

MetaCastOnMinionDeathPlayer.description: While active, gains Energy when one of your Persistent Minions is Killed, and triggers socketed Spells upon reaching maximum Energy. Very underlevelled Minions will incur an Energy generation penalty. Cannot socket Spells which create Minions.
MetaCastOnMinionDeathPlayer.name: Cast on Minion Death

MetaDeadeyeMarksPlayer.description: Applies a socketed Mark Skill to a nearby unmarked Enemy every few seconds. Consuming socketed Marks will cause them to be reapplied to an unmarked Enemy. This reapplication can happen at most once every few seconds.
MetaDeadeyeMarksPlayer.name: Called Shots

MetaElementalInvocationPlayer.description: While active, gains Energy when you Freeze, Shock or Ignite an enemy. Using the Invocation once sufficient Energy is gathered will consume the Energy to trigger socketed Spells, and can trigger them multiple times if it has enough Energy.
MetaElementalInvocationPlayer.name: Elemental Invocation

MetaFeralInvocationPlayer.description: While active, gains Energy when you spend Mana. Using the Invocation once sufficient Energy is gathered will consume the Energy to create visages which attack once with a socketed Shapeshifting Attack, creating multiple visages if it has enough Energy.
MetaFeralInvocationPlayer.name: Feral Invocation

MetaHollowFormPlayer.description: Channel to create fleeting images of your astral self near the target location. The images perform a Socketed Melee Attack once then vanish, targeting the closest enemy if possible. The images cannot perform Channelled Skills or Conditional Skills. Consuming a Power Charge creates additional images.
MetaHollowFormPlayer.name: Hollow Form

MetaMirageArcherPlayer.description: While active, dodge rolling will create a Mirage that uses socketed ranged Attacks for a short duration, then vanish.
MetaMirageArcherPlayer.name: Mirage Archer

MetaMirageDeadeyePlayer.description: While active, firing a ranged Projectile Attack will create a Mirage that uses socketed ranged Attacks for a short duration, then vanish.
MetaMirageDeadeyePlayer.name: Mirage Deadeye

MetaMortarCannonPlayer.description: Raise a cannon Ballista Totem which uses socketed Grenade Skills, with significantly improved Cooldown Recovery Rate.
MetaMortarCannonPlayer.name: Mortar Cannon

MetaReapersInvocationPlayer.description: While active, gains Energy when you kill an enemy with a Melee Attack. Using the Invocation once sufficient Energy is gathered will consume the Energy to trigger socketed Spells, and can trigger them multiple times if it has enough Energy.
MetaReapersInvocationPlayer.name: Reaper's Invocation

MetaRemnantsOfKalguurPlayer.description: While active, enemies you Stun or kill have a chance to generate a Runic Ward Remnant. These Remnants can Overflow your Runic Ward.
MetaRemnantsOfKalguurPlayer.name: Remnants of Kalguur

MetaSpellslingerPlayer.description: While active, gains Energy when you cast Spells. Using the Invocation once sufficient Energy is gathered will consume the Energy to trigger socketed Spells, and can trigger them multiple times if it has enough Energy.
MetaSpellslingerPlayer.name: Spellslinger

MeteorFireDjinn.description: Command Ruzhan to teleport to the target location. Upon arrival, the Djinn deals Spell damage to enemies around him then slams his blazing sword into the ground, creating a wave of lava that also deals Spell damage.
MeteorFireDjinn.name: Ruzhan's Reckoning

MidnightStarPlayer.description: While active, Critical Hits with other skills that kill targets, or hit powerful targets cause you to gain Arctic Petals. Once you have enough Arctic Petals they will be Consumed to create Ice Crystals near the most recent target.
MidnightStarPlayer.name: Midnight Zenith

MirrorOfRefractionPlayer.description: Mirrors of Refraction appear in your Presence periodically. Hitting a mirror with a Spell Projectile causes it to shatter, copying the projectiles in a nova around the destroyed mirror. Copied Projectiles may be copied again when colliding with other mirrors.
MirrorOfRefractionPlayer.name: Mirror of Refraction

MoltenBlastPlayer.description: Gouge molten rock from the ground and fling it at the target. The Projectile explodes on collision, damaging enemies and scattering shrapnel in a cone behind it.
MoltenBlastPlayer.name: Molten Blast

MoltenCrashPlayer.description: Shapeshift into a burning monstrosity and leap through the air to crash down upon the earth, Slamming twice and creating Molten Fissures. Consumes Rage to create additional Molten Fissures.
MoltenCrashPlayer.name: Molten Crash

MomentOfVulnerabilityPlayer.description: Send out a temporal Nova to take advantage of enemies' moment of vulnerability. Hitting enemies that are Primed for Stun, Electrocution, or Freeze causes a visage of them to appear, lasting as long as the original target would have been affected by the form of Immobilisation used to create the visage. A portion of the damage dealt to visages is also dealt to the original.
MomentOfVulnerabilityPlayer.name: Moment of Vulnerability

NightfallEmbraceTheFallPlayer.description: Teleport to your thrown Shield, appearing in the air and Slamming it into the ground to deal damage in an area. Destroying an Ice Crystal with this skill skips the cooldown of Soaring Midnight.
NightfallEmbraceTheFallPlayer.name: Embrace The Fall

NightfallSoaringMidnightPlayer.description: Hurl your Shield as a Projectile which Returns to you at the end of its flight. While the Shield is in flight, this skill is replaced with Embrace the Fall. This skill's cooldown is skipped if you catch the Shield as it Returns, or destroy an Ice Crystal with the Embrace the Fall.
NightfallSoaringMidnightPlayer.name: Soaring Midnight

OilBarragePlayer.description: Shapeshift into a Wyvern and spit Oil at enemies, creating Oil Ground where the Projectiles land. Consumes Power Charges if possible to instead Channel a sustained barrage of electrified Oil that does not create Oil Ground. Projectiles are fired in sequence, allowing multiple Projectiles to Hit the same target.
OilBarragePlayer.name: Oil Barrage

OilGrenadePlayer.description: Fire a bouncing Grenade that bursts in a spray of Oil when the fuse expires or when it impacts an Enemy, dealing minimal damage but covering the ground and nearby enemies in Oil. Oil created this way can be Ignited by Detonator Skills or Ignited Ground.
OilGrenadePlayer.name: Oil Grenade

OrbOfStormsPlayer.description: Create an Orb of electricity that fires Chaining Lightning bolts at nearby enemies. The Orb leaves behind a Lightning Infusion Remnant when it expires.
OrbOfStormsPlayer.name: Orb of Storms

OverwhelmingPresencePlayer.description: While active, emits an Aura that makes enemies in your Presence easier to Stun and inflict Elemental Ailments upon.
OverwhelmingPresencePlayer.name: Overwhelming Presence

PainOfferingPlayer.description: Skewer a Skeleton on a bone spike to send nearby Minions into a frenzy as long as the spike remains, making their skills faster and harder hitting.  The bone spike is itself a Minion. If it dies, the effect ends immediately.
PainOfferingPlayer.name: Pain Offering

ParryPlayer.description: Ready your Buckler to parry the next Hit you would take, Blocking the Hit and retaliating with a quick sweep that leaves enemies off balance, causing them to take massively increased Attack damage for a short duration. Parrying causes you to accumulate Heavy Stun buildup. You cannot Evade a Hit you could parry, but Evasion instead grants an equal chance to avoid this Heavy Stun buildup.
ParryPlayer.name: Parry

PassiveTriggeredManaWaveWaterDjinn.description: When you Command Navira to use a Skill, she also emits a restorative wave that grants you and any other Allies it touches increased Mana Regeneration for a short duration.
PassiveTriggeredManaWaveWaterDjinn.name: Navira's Calming

PerfectStrikePlayer.description: Channel to charge up your weapon with Fire. Releasing with Perfect Timing will create a damaging wave of intense Fire.
PerfectStrikePlayer.name: Perfect Strike

PermafrostBoltsAmmoPlayer.description: Load your Crossbow with icy bolts that fragment in flight, damaging enemies on hit and in a small cone behind their final target. The icy coating on the bolts makes them extremely potent at Freezing enemies. These fragments can Merge.
PermafrostBoltsAmmoPlayer.name: Load Permafrost Bolts

PermafrostBoltsPlayer.description: Fire icy bolts that  fragment in flight, damaging enemies on hit and in a small cone behind their final target. The icy coating on the bolts makes them extremely potent at Freezing enemies. These fragments can Merge.
PermafrostBoltsPlayer.name: Permafrost Bolts

PhantasmalArrowPlayer.description: Fires an arrow that embeds where it lands for a short duration. At the end of the duration, the arrow explodes in spectral flame, turning it to ashes and damaging enemies, with a high chance to Ignite. Igniting any enemy with the Explosion also applies Ignite to enemies within range.
PhantasmalArrowPlayer.name: Phantasmal Arrow

PinnacleOfPowerPlayer.description: Consume all Power Charges to master the elements, gaining Elemental Damage and the ability to apply Elemental Ailments with other damage types. Can only be used while you have maximum Power Charges.
PinnacleOfPowerPlayer.name: Pinnacle of Power

PlagueBearerPlayer.description: While active, stores a portion of the Poison Damage you deal. Using this Skill unleashes the stored Poison to damage and Poison enemies around you.
PlagueBearerPlayer.name: Plague Bearer

PlagueBurstPlayer.description: Triggered when an enemy Poisoned by a supported skill dies, dealing Physical damage around them based on the built-up Plague.
PlagueBurstPlayer.name: Plague Burst

PlasmaBlastAmmoPlayer.description: Load your Crossbow with unstable bolts that require a lengthy charging period to fire but deal devastating damage, Pierce through enemies, and explode upon hitting terrain. Additional Projectiles are fired in a spread, unlike other Crossbow Skills.
PlasmaBlastAmmoPlayer.name: Load Plasma Blast

PlasmaBlastPlayer.description: Channel to charge an unstable bolt. The bolt deals devastating damage and explodes on hitting terrain, but cannot be fired at all unless fully charged. Additional Projectiles are fired in a spread, unlike other Crossbow Skills.
PlasmaBlastPlayer.name: Plasma Blast

PoisonBurstArrowPlayer.description: Fire a virulent arrow that creates a burst of Poison on hit, affecting all enemies in an area.
PoisonBurstArrowPlayer.name: Poisonburst Arrow

PowerSiphonPlayer.description: Attempt to rip the lifeforce from an enemy. Enemies within Culling range will be highlighted and instantly killed on Hit, granting a Power Charge. Can only target Enemies in Culling range.
PowerSiphonPlayer.name: Power Siphon

PoweredByVerisiumPlayer.description: Spends Ward to generate Verisium Infusions, which can be used in place of any Elemental Infusions.
PoweredByVerisiumPlayer.name: Powered by Verisium

PrimalBountyPlayer.description: Empowers the next Projectile Skill you use, causing it to create additional Projectiles and fly faster.
PrimalBountyPlayer.name: Primal Bounty

PrimalStrikesPlayer.description: Perform a Lightning-charged stab that can be chained into a combination of up to three attacks. The first two attacks conjure a charging Wildwood spirit if they Hit a Shocked enemy and refresh Shock duration. The third attack is a large swipe that inflicts Elemental Exposure, and can Consume Shock to conjure a stampede of spirits.
PrimalStrikesPlayer.name: Primal Strikes

ProfaneRitualPlayer.description: Mark a Corpse with a profane rune, dealing Chaos damage over time to nearby enemies. When the ritual is complete the Corpse is consumed and you gain a Power Charge.
ProfaneRitualPlayer.name: Profane Ritual

ProlongedDurationSupportPlayer.description: Supports any skill that has a duration, making that duration longer.
ProlongedDurationSupportPlayer.name: Prolonged Duration I

ProlongedDurationSupportPlayerTwo.description: Supports any skill that has a duration, making that duration longer.
ProlongedDurationSupportPlayerTwo.name: Prolonged Duration II

PurityOfFirePlayer.description: Emit an Aura that boosts the Fire Resistance of you and Allies in your Presence.
PurityOfFirePlayer.name: Purity of Fire

PurityOfIcePlayer.description: Emit an Aura that boosts the Cold Resistance of you and Allies in your Presence.
PurityOfIcePlayer.name: Purity of Ice

PurityOfLightningPlayer.description: Emit an Aura that boosts the Lightning Resistance of you and Allies in your Presence.
PurityOfLightningPlayer.name: Purity of Lightning

RagingSpiritsPlayer.description: While active, Fire Spells you use yourself will also summon Raging Spirits, which are short-lived flaming skulls that rush at nearby enemies and rapidly Attack them, ignoring commands. Enemies will not directly engage these Minions, and can pass through them.
RagingSpiritsPlayer.name: Raging Spirits

RainOfArrowsPlayer.description: Fire a hail of arrows into the air, causing them to rain from above. Consumes a Frenzy Charge to fire more arrows.
RainOfArrowsPlayer.name: Rain of Arrows
